::: {#exr-pairs}
#### Every a needs a b

A program reads a string (@def-string) of the symbols $\mathtt{a}$ and $\mathtt{b}$,
and must check that every $\mathtt{a}$ in it is immediately followed by a $\mathtt{b}$.
Which of these strings pass the check?

$$
\mathtt{abab}, \quad \mathtt{aab}, \quad \mathtt{ba}, \quad \mathtt{bbab}, \quad \lambda
$$

:::
